name: Y'all Got Any More of That
aka: Y'all Got Any More of Them
look: A TV still of Dave Chappelle as Tyrone Biggums, in a red knit beanie and a worn tan coat over a dark hoodie, scratching at his neck with a pleading, twitchy look on a dark street at night.
use: The captions beg for more of something the poster can't get enough of, in the form Y'all got any more of that..., with the twitchy character showing a desperate craving.
slots: Y'all got any more of that... (top)
the thing you want more of (bottom)
examples: Y'all got any more of them
Y'all got any more of that
describe: dave chappelle scratching his neck asking for more
guy in a red beanie itching and begging for more
twitchy man in a winter hat asking if you have any more
comedy sketch character scratching himself desperately
man in a beanie and coat at night craving more of something
origin: Dave Chappelle as the character Tyrone Biggums in a sketch from his Comedy Central series Chappelle's Show.
